name: Hum Note
summary: Hold to record a voice note with a live waveform; slide to bin it, lift to lock, release to send
about: A chat with a real voice-note composer. Hold the mic and it swells into a red orb with ripples while a live waveform scrolls by; slide left and the recording rolls into a bin that gulps it, slide up to lock it hands-free, or let go and the waveform flies up into the thread as a bubble that earns its ticks and a heart. Every bubble plays with a moving head, scrubs by drag or arrow keys and switches between 1x, 1.5x and 2x; open it full screen to record your own voice.
how: Hold the mic button to record, or tap it (or press Enter) to record hands-free.
While holding, slide left past the hint to delete the recording, or slide up to lock it.
Release, or press the Send arrow when locked, and the note flies into the chat with clock, tick, double tick and blue.
Press Play on any note, drag along its bars to jump, and tap 1x to change the speed. Demo notes hum softly.
Demo voice switches to My mic to use your real microphone; typing a message turns the mic into Send.
